book.title: Matiyu Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Matiyuyaŋ meluwaŋ mge

content: Zisasiyaŋ an wesiŋ ŋen weyaŋpeye
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ waŋgaen ewe moti gilik zem ikŋaŋgalen mka temaneset koge.
Pataŋ zeme an ŋen wesiŋ loe mkobien. Âpme Zisasiyaŋ nâmkiŋpepeŋin igagen ke ekmâtâti an wesiŋ ke pigok dunduye, “Nemun, nâm nukŋaŋ mimipiŋ. Yomdi ilak katikpeyap.”
Kegok zeme zii zet zikat indanda ekŋenaŋ kapigok zenâ zenâ mbien, “An kapi ziboŋ? Ek Kawawaŋ nemboŋ yek yaŋgut, ‘Yomdi katikpeyap,’ ke zein. An bekanaŋ penaŋ.”
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ keŋinan ekmâtâti kapigok diindoye, “Keŋinan zet bekanaŋ keboŋ ke eneyet taotnâip?
Neŋ mulup zut kapi mimiyelen winde nanaŋaŋaŋ tatnain: Am yomin katikpepeyelen ma am, ‘Wati melit,’ zemindema mebegalen kogogak winden tatnain.

Alak nen mulup msap kapi e in neŋ Angat Nemuŋaŋ winde ke nanaŋaŋ yaŋaŋ nâmâtâseip. Kapigok Kawawaŋgalen winde tatnain keyepm neŋ am msalen yomin ŋep katikpepeyelen.” Kegok zemti an kapigok dunduye, “Wati loendi pumti mkandan met.”
Zempeme an egaŋ wati mkaŋan mege.
Âpme am sambe ekŋenaŋ ekti, Kawawaŋgalen winde keboŋ ke ammagen mge keyepmti nâmtemtem mti Kawawaŋ zemsesewatpewien.
Zisas ek an bekanaŋ mimi ekŋenmak totati tu meu niŋge
Âpme Zisas ek keyetnaŋ meti mânep takis titi munduman tapme mege. Meti mânep takis titi an ke aikge. Ke neŋ. Kwitn Matiyu.
Neŋ tapma Zisasiyaŋ koti nikti dinoye, “Geŋ koti neŋmak tusu.” Kegok dinome neŋ keyegak wati ek mâti meban.
Meti nâlen mkaen meu niniyelen Zisas zemtetimti mobelin. Âpme am yomtoŋ ma an takis mânep titi notnne sambeyaŋ kopme Zisas ma nembaŋane ninsakwep meu nimbenn.
Kegok mmann Palisi notnaŋaŋ ndikti Zisas nembaŋaŋne ningat zewien, “An zikat indandaŋin eneyet an mânep takis butnaŋ kambu matip ekŋenmak am yomtoŋ temakwep tati tu meu tatnip?”
Zet ke Zisasiyaŋ nâmti bemzenze zet ŋen diindoye, “Doktayaŋ am dolakŋaŋ zawalinpiŋ ekŋenmagen mulup ku mamin. Zawatmak ekŋenmagen etaŋ muluwin mamin.
In meti Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ kapigok tazin keyet yaŋaŋ weyaŋekmâtâlit,

content.text: ‘Kawawaŋaŋ zeye, “Neŋ in am aŋgalaŋ gogot mimindemti mama keyet nâmtikŋaŋ mamiyap. Wa in neŋmak keŋin kwetetepmaŋ beme mamayet sâpe sâpe mambup ke yek.”’ (Hosea 6:6)

content: An ek ikŋaŋgat sekŋaŋ moti zein, ‘Neŋ a yomtoŋ yek; An dolakŋaŋ penaŋ,’ zein ke neŋ an keboŋ ke ku indamukulem mimiyelen kolap. Ma an ek ikŋaŋgat sekŋaŋ mtoti zein, ‘Neŋ yommak,’ tazein an keboŋ ke neŋ indamukulem mimiyelen kolap.”
Zisasiyaŋ tu meu zemkulumpemti belak mamayelen zemzikat indaye

Kan ŋengat Zân an tu zululut egalen nemba ekŋenaŋ Zisasmagen koti yaŋkwesiwien, “Nin ma Palisi an msasa sambenik tu meu zemkulumpemti keŋ sindem matatnup. Kwilekiyet mti gâlen nembandine ekŋenaŋ eneyet tu meu ku zemkulumpemti talip?”

Kegok zeme Zisasiyaŋ bemzenze zet pigok zeye, “An ŋenaŋ imbiŋaŋ wasât mti notnanemak tapme ekŋenaŋ oloŋen penaŋ tati tu meu nimwiaŋti tatnepeme an imbi wasâgât mge egat kasaŋane ekŋenaŋ koti mandamepme kan keyet notnaneyaŋ keŋ sindem palen ma meu zemkulumpemti tabep.”
Set itnaŋaŋmak Zisasiyelen set alakŋaŋmak pepep ŋep ku tabuk

Zisasiyaŋ zet ŋen kapigok zeye, “Mka tokan tuŋgupmanen etimbembeŋaŋ alakŋaŋ antimti ku weyaŋ bek. Weyaŋsât tapmnepemane egaŋ bululuŋ zemtobodak. Keyepmti alakŋaŋ etaŋaŋ mpemane dolakŋaŋ kaliŋaŋ tadak.”

Bemzenze ŋen naman pigok zeye, “Am ŋenaŋ siŋgapoŋ sâŋsâŋ busât selik itnaŋaŋ peweweŋaŋgat ku bunak. Bunak beme seligaŋ sakwep epeeme siŋgapoŋ sâŋsâŋ kwawadak. Keyepmti selik alakŋanen bunak beme dolakŋaŋ zinak.”
Zisasiyaŋ an ŋeŋaŋgat nemuŋaŋ gakikiengatnan mme wage
Zisas ek bemzenze zet ke zemti tapme an damuŋ eget kandaŋan kot pedondom samti zeye, “Namban alakŋati kapi gakin keyepmti geŋ gapmepma met teŋgumane ewe gilik zem wasem.”
Kegok zemti mepme Zisas ma nembaŋane nin mâti mebenn.
Tapmepmann imbi ŋen sipmaŋ nup kan 12 omba penaŋ belak makwawetan. Keyaŋ Zisas mâti meti egalen sâkŋaŋ butnaŋ etaŋ atasâgât nâŋge.
Keŋaŋaŋ kapigok otnâye, “Sâkŋaŋ etaŋ atasap beme dolakŋaŋ besap.”
Kegok nâmti Zisasiyelen sakŋaŋ butnaŋ atame Zisasiyaŋ gilik zemti ekti zeye, “Ipm, nâmnukŋaŋ mimipiŋ. Nâmkiŋpependimakgapm dolakŋaŋ benik.” Zeme keyegak imbiyaŋ dolakŋaŋ beye.
Âpme Zisas egaŋ metneti an damuŋ keyelen mka keŋan mowege. Moweti eget mkaen am notnaŋaŋ si silik kwisak ma am notnaŋgalen si zemsu zemsu nâye.
Ke nâmti diindoye, “In ilinsakwep wati towepmâlit. Imbi nemba ek ku gakip; ek muluk tawen.” Kegok zeme am ekŋenaŋ Zisas ekyeŋbien.
Âpme indamâpme towepme delaŋ zeme egaŋ imbi nemba gakikiŋaŋ tage mka keŋan ke meti imbi nemba betnanen atame wage.
Âpme keyet zapatnaŋaŋ msat keyet keŋan palakŋaŋ bemege.
Zisasiyaŋ an zut zikalit beŋaŋ weyaŋideye
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ msat ke pemti mepme an zikalit beŋaŋ zut egelaŋ ek mâti kwizet kwawet kwawet mti zewun, “Geŋ amobotnaŋ Dewitgalen alikŋaŋaŋ, nigat kembeŋ bugan mi?”
Zeme egaŋ meti mkaen mowepme, an zulaŋ kandaŋan mowepmalu idayaŋkwesimti zeye, “Neŋ zikalit weyaŋidendeyelen ke ŋep nâmkiŋpelup, ma?” Zeme egelaŋ zewun, “Amobotnaŋ, nit nâmkiŋpemgelup.”
Kegok zemalu Zisasiyaŋ zikalit timekti zeye, “Nâmkiŋpepeŋidaŋgat penaŋaŋ nâlup kegok idaktimekma sokbemidak.”
Atame keyegak zikalit ekbun. Ekmalu Zisasiyaŋ amgat ku zemsokbembeyet zemkulumidemti kapigok diidoye, “Nâlup, it keyet zapatnaŋ am ŋen ku diindomalu nâseip.”
Yaŋgut egelaŋ zet ke nâmpemti zet zapatnaŋ zemalu msat keyet keŋan palakŋaŋ bemti mepmâge.
Zisasiyaŋ an zetnepiŋ weyaŋpeye
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ mepme keyegak am notnaŋaŋ an zetnepiŋ wati kobien. An ke we bekanaŋaŋ mpeme zetnepiŋ bembeŋaŋ.
Zisasiyaŋ we bekanaŋ mâpme mepme an egaŋ zetnaŋ zeye. Zeme am maŋga temaŋ tabien ekŋenaŋ nâmtemtem mti zewien, “Islael msalen muluwaŋ keboŋ ŋen ku sokbeme ekbenn.”
Palisi an ekŋenaŋ zewien, “We bekanaŋ ekŋengalen amobotnaŋaŋ mukulem mpeme we bekanaŋ taindapmâzin.”
Zisasiyaŋ am indikti kembeŋ mge

Âpme Zisasiyaŋ mulup kegok ke mti mka temaŋ isikŋaŋ mame delaŋ zeye ma sesewat mka ŋen ŋen Kawawaŋgalen zemâtâtâtgat katnanen mama keyelen Zet Zapatnaŋ Dolakŋaŋ diindoye. Diindomti zawat liŋgit, sek sindemak mme dolakŋaŋ etaŋ bewien.
Âpme am maŋge temaŋ indikti ekŋengat keŋaŋ kembeŋ penaŋ beye. Ekŋen pembenaŋ bembeyelen keŋ yayaŋ mbienaŋgut mukulemin ku aikbien. Ekŋen sipsip damuŋinpiŋ mamti kileŋ maip sepem keboŋ mambien.
Keyepm nembaŋane ningat kapigok diindoye, “Kawawaŋgalen mulup sambe penaŋ tazin âpme mulup an imbi sambe yek. Kwep kwewetaŋ.
Keyepmti in mulup toŋaŋ dundum same mulup mimi an imbi aikindeme mulupmane sakwep mepmâbep.”

footnotes.text: Lugaŋ Matiyuyet kwitnaŋ egaŋ Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ kuyeen Liwai kuye. Kwit zut kapi an kwepgat kwitnaŋ.

Bemzenze zet kapiyet yaŋaŋ: Zisasiyaŋ an imbiŋaŋ wasât mge zeye ke Zisas ikŋaŋ. Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋanemak tati oloŋen palen tabien ya kan keyet kasa ekŋengat belinan mopme ekŋenaŋ tewen kume nembaŋane ekŋenaŋ keŋ sindem palen tabien.
Bemzenze zet kapi zet yaŋaŋ pigok: set itnaŋaŋmak Zisasiyelen set alakŋaŋmak pepep ŋep ku tabuk.
